label: product launch transition process: Assess engineering change impact on workforce — Analyze product design changes and engineering modifications to identify required workforce skill gaps and retraining needs.

args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## ⭐ WORKFORCE SKILL GAPS & RETRAINING (Product Launch Transitions)
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering change requests and employee competencies; evaluates capability gaps; recommends targeted development/reassignment actions; facilitates dynamic workforce planning relative to design changes; BEST FIT for assessing engineering change impact on workforce

## HAZMAT & SUBSTANCE COMPLIANCE ⭐⭐⭐
- **my.mes:agent:HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor:v1** - Monitors hazardous substance handling and incidents; detects compliance deviations; coordinates supplier notifications; processes corrective actions; ensures regulatory adherence and safe material management across procurement/production lifecycle; relatedEntityTypes: HazardousSubstance, Incident, SafetyIncident

## CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT & PRODUCTION TRANSITION ⭐⭐⭐
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes & material updates; triggers coordinated customer engagement campaigns; orchestrates targeted sales communications to affected customer segments; coordinates inventory synchronization; processes product lifecycle transitions

## SAFETY & COMPLIANCE REPORTING ⭐⭐⭐
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Autonomously analyzes SafetyIncidents; generates structured root cause analysis reports with regulatory impact; supports audit trails and evidence-based documentation
- **emarsys.cx:agent:IncidentComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - Detects regulatory risks in customer engagement programs; orchestrates compliance procedures & remediation; validates adherence to safety governance; tracks adverse events and regulatory exposures; maintains visibility into regulatory posture across customer lifecycle

## PROCUREMENT SAFETY COMPLIANCE ⭐⭐⭐
- **emarsys.cx:agent:IncidentComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - Best fit for assessing customer safety campaign readiness; reviews safety compliance requirements for customer accounts; identifies regulatory gaps in engagement initiatives; maintains real-time compliance visibility

## INBOUND MATERIAL RECEIPT & INSPECTION ⭐⭐⭐
- **my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1** - Processes incoming material inspections; monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance; orchestrates quality certifications against POs and contracts; escalates non-conformance issues to vendors; maintains manufacturing standards

## BOM COMPLIANCE VALIDATION ⭐⭐⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - Validates BOMs against regulatory/supplier qualification requirements; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance documentation

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & ENGINEERING CHANGE COMPLIANCE ⭐⭐⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - Coordinates engineering changes; orchestrates material provisioning; synchronizes configuration updates; related entity types: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes & material modifications; coordinates updates across product items & purchase orders; ensures procurement network propagation

## SERVICE & CHANGE REQUEST TICKETS ⭐⭐⭐
- **corp.itsm:agent:ChangeReleaseCoordinator:v1** - Automates product releases; generates formal change requests and service tickets to track implementation tasks

## MASTER MATERIAL & VENDOR DATA RETRIEVAL ⭐⭐⭐
- **sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1** - Analyzes purchase requisitions against vendor master data, material specifications, historical performance metrics; evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings; supports procurement planning

## SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION & SERVICE CAPABILITY ASSESSMENT ⭐⭐⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1** - Automates vendor assessment and material qualification workflows; monitors vendor compliance status; processes supplier performance metrics; orchestrates qualification reviews; manages material-to-vendor mappings across PLM ecosystem
- **sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1** - Validates material specifications against supplier qualifications; tag: supplier-qualification; use case explicitly includes procurement officer confirming supplier certifications
